title: A dual genome-methylome map of clonal evolution in grapevine.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Listed Zenodo record 18154549 via its API (CC-BY-4.0): one diploid assembly FASTA (284 MB), gene and TE (transposable element) GFF3 annotations (14-16 MB), and CG/CHG/CHH bedMethyl files (331 MB, 347 MB, 2.79 GB) for the reference clone 20-13 only. Code record 20964347 is a 0.2 MB code zip. Opened all 11 sheets of the supplementary xlsx (MOESM3): all are summary tables; Table S11 has 23 clones x yield/sugar/acidity BLUPs (best linear unbiased predictions, i.e. adjusted field-trait means).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Counts of 67,277 somatic SNPs (single-letter DNA changes), 4,037 SVs (structural variants) and ~100k methylation polymorphisms across the 23 clones; no per-clone variant or methylation-polymorphism table appears in Zenodo or the supplement, so these exist only as text claims and raw Nanopore reads in ENA PRJEB106155.

a1_downloadable.note: Zenodo files and ENA raw reads are open, no login; checked the Zenodo file listing.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No per-clone somatic variant or differential methylation table is deposited (checked Zenodo and supplement); any site-level label would have to be rebuilt by re-calling variants and methylation from raw Nanopore reads for 23 clones.

a3_inputs_present.note: Per-clone methylation is only in raw ENA Nanopore data (forbidden to download here); the processed bedMethyl covers only the reference clone.

a4_units_stated.note: Table S11 trait units stated (g/m2, °Brix, g/L); bedMethyl is a standard format.

a5_enough_rows.note: The clone-level phenotype table has 23 rows (seen in Table S11); far under the 400-row classification minimum.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: Raw Nanopore for 23 clones at ~29x coverage of a ~500 Mb genome, tens to hundreds of GB
a6_fits_laptop.note: Rebuilding per-clone labels needs raw-read basecalling/mapping, far beyond 5 GB and a laptop CPU.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: 23 clones in Table S8/S11 match the abstract; site-level counts not checkable.

a8_label_provenance.note: Traits are field measurements (BLUP-adjusted); methylation calls would come from a Nanopore basecaller model, a mild concern but not fatal.

backbone.name: None evaluated (a DNA language model such as Nucleotide Transformer would be the candidate)

honest_claim_h3: Not reached: no per-clone processed variant or methylation table exists to define a label.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use DNA sequence around each site to predict where methylation differs between grapevine clones.
plain_idea.train_on: Genomic windows of the Pinot noir reference; number of labelled sites unknown because the per-clone methylation-polymorphism table is not deposited.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a site's DNA methylation varies among 23 clones, which would have to be re-derived from raw Nanopore reads.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would tell grape breeders which genomic regions carry heritable epigenetic clone differences; but the labels are not publicly available in processed form.

ml_idea: Site-level prediction of clonal methylation polymorphisms from sequence context; blocked because only the reference clone's methylation is deposited, and clone-level traits have n=23.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; labels would require reprocessing raw Nanopore reads for 23 clones, which needs basecalling-scale compute.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Check Zenodo and the supplement for a per-clone variant/methylation table: done, none found.

verdict_reason: Fails A2/A3/A5: the deposited processed methylation covers only the reference clone, the per-clone variant and methylation calls exist only as raw ENA reads, and the clone-level trait table has 23 rows.
